title: comdirect-fetch: Cashflow & Kosten
description: Ein-/Ausgaben je Zeitraum, Ausgaben nach Kategorie, Gebührenübersicht – KONZEPT.md Abschnitt 6, Phase 3. Interne Umbuchungen zwischen eigenen Konten sind ausgeschlossen (category type InternNeutral).

panels.title: Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Netto je Monat
panels.description: Summe je Kategorie-Typ (Einnahme/Ausgabe) und Buchungsmonat, plus Netto (Einnahme − Ausgabe). Interne Umbuchungen ausgeschlossen.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS time, c.type AS metric, SUM(t.amount) AS value
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.type IN ('Einnahme', 'Ausgabe') AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01'), c.type
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS time, 'Netto' AS metric, SUM(t.amount) AS value
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.type IN ('Einnahme', 'Ausgabe') AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time

SELECT c.name AS `Kategorie`, SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS `Betrag`
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.type = 'Ausgabe' AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY `Betrag` DESC

SELECT c.name AS `Kategorie`, COUNT(*) AS `Anzahl`, SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS `Betrag`
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.type = 'Ausgabe' AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY `Betrag` DESC

SELECT CAST(DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS DATE) AS time, c.name AS metric, SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS value
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.name IN ('Kontoführungsgebühren', 'Ordergebühren') AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.booking_date, '%Y-%m-01'), c.name
ORDER BY time

SELECT SUM(ABS(t.amount)) AS `Gebuehren`
FROM transactions t
JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id
WHERE c.name IN ('Kontoführungsgebühren', 'Ordergebühren') AND $__timeFilter(t.booking_date)
